facts.text: The State College Tuition Guarantee enables Pell-eligible resident and non-resident undergraduates to attend Chadron State tuition-free.

sources.title: Tuition Guarantee | Chadron State College
sources.quote: The State College Tuition Guarantee ensures that Pell-eligible resident and non-resident students can attend Chadron State tuition-free. The program applies to new undergraduate and transfer students at Chadron State College.
